description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Ratio (%) achieved by three different models across three distinct categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Ratio (%)", utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 50 to 90, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal gridlines spaced at intervals of 10 units. The chart employs grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three side-by-side bars. As indicated by the legend at the top of the chart, the blue bars represent Llama3, the red bars represent Qwen2, and the yellow bars represent ChatGPT. In the Movies category, the red Qwen2 bar is the tallest at approximately 89%, closely followed by the blue Llama3 bar at roughly 88%, while the yellow ChatGPT bar is at about 73%. For the Songs category, Qwen2 is again the highest at approximately 88%, Llama3 is near 84%, and ChatGPT is roughly 63%. In the Basketball category, Llama3 is the tallest at approximately 67%, ChatGPT is around 62%, and Qwen2 represents the shortest bar in the entire chart at approximately 58%. The categories and the bars within each group are not sorted by height or alphabetically, maintaining a consistent model order across all groups, and no specific bars are visually emphasized.
